paragraphs.text: Vadax Gor is a Rakdos criminal who was arrested by the Azorius for kidnapping. His face is ravaged with scars, piercings, and tattoos. Tattered scraps that barely qualified as clothing hang lazily from his malnourished frame.

For months, Vadax Gor associated himself with a Rakdos diversion club, enjoying all manner of depravity. No longer satisfied to keep his actions contained to the Rakdos , he caused the disappearance of two citizens. This put the Azorius arrester Parisha on his trail.

Vadax Gor had a deal with a leatherworker, whose shop was conveniently located near a dark alley. The leatherworker would scope out his customers, and send those deemed easy targets down that way, where Vadax Gor was waiting. One day, a homunculus named Fblthp showed up at the shop, asking the owner to sign some forms in triplicate. The leatherworker did his usual routine, but something made him suspect that not everything was as it seemed, and he sent some thugs out into the back street to look for trouble.

Fblthp's visit was indeed a ploy by Parisha, and when the homunculus walked down the alley and was snatched by Vadax Gor, Azorius agents stepped forth. The leatherworker's thugs struck back though, keeping the agents at bay. Vadax Gor bolted down the alley, Fblthp in hand, but after a brief chase, he was caught up by Parisha, who threw an arrester's ring on him, locking him tight with magic. Vadax Gor was trapped, and Parisha claimed Fblthp from his arms and locked the criminal up. The Rakdos criminal's fate after that is unknown.
